snippet.title: Braided Bun with Braiding Hair Extensions Tutorial
snippet.description:
Celebrity hairstylist Kherrington Leslie shows us how to use Ruka Hair braiding hair extensions on Sephora Squad member Jessica to enhance her beautiful natural hair and create a sleek spiky braided bun.

In this step-by-step braiding hair tutorial, Kherrington demonstrates how to prep, section, cornrow, and braid natural hair before adding Ruka braiding hair for extra length, volume, and structure. Follow along as she shares natural hair braiding techniques, creates clean cornrows, secures the hair extensions, smooths the edges, and shapes the finished braids into a statement spiky bun.

This natural hair braiding style combines cornrows, protective braids, and a braided bun for a creative protective hairstyle. It is a great option for anyone looking for natural hair bun styles, natural hair extensions hairstyles, or new ways to style braiding hair on natural hair.

To recreate this spiky bun tutorial, you’ll need edge control, a comb, sectioning clips, a flat iron, hair oil, hair ties, and Ruka Hair braiding extensions.

snippet.title: How to Create Soft Waterfall Waves on Long Hair
snippet.description:
Learn how to create soft waterfall waves on long hair with celebrity hairstylist Glen “Coco” Oropeza and Sephora Squad member Seerat Saini. Also known as Hollywood waves, glam waves, or soft glam curls, this trending hairstyle creates smooth, flowing waves with a polished, high-shine finish.

In this step-by-step waterfall waves tutorial, Glen Coco demonstrates how to prep long hair with heat protectant, use a 1.5-inch curling iron to create soft, uniform waves, and shape the curls into a glamorous Hollywood-inspired hairstyle. snippet.title: Dermatologist Explains Ectoin, Peptides & Exosomes
snippet.description:
Learn more about these new 2026 trending skincare ingredients with board-certified dermatologist Dr. Dustin Portela. In this skincare education video, Dr. Portela breaks down three new trending skincare ingredients -- ectoin, peptides, and exosomes -- including what they are, how they work, and why they’re becoming popular in modern skincare routines.

Learn how ectoin can help support the skin barrier and defend against environmental stressors, how peptides can help improve the look of firmness, fine lines, and skin texture, and what exosomes are in skincare. From hydration and barrier repair to smoother-looking skin and a healthier-looking complexion, this dermatologist-led guide explains the science behind innovative skincare ingredients and how to think about adding them to your routine.
